title.zh: 卷十八 列傳第六: 景穆十二王下
title.raw: 卷十八 列傳第六: 景穆十二王下 Volume 18 Biographies 6: Jingmu's Twelve Sons 2

sentences.zh: 景穆十二王下

translations.literal: Jingmu's Twelve Sons, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Jingmu's Twelve Sons (Part 2)

sentences.zh: 列傳第六景穆十二王下

translations.literal: Biographies 6: Jingmu's Twelve Sons, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 6 — Jingmu's Twelve Sons (Part 2)

sentences.zh: 任城王雲，和平五年封。

translations.literal: Yun, Prince of Rencheng, was enfeoffed in the fifth year of Heping.
translations.idiomatic: Yun, Prince of Rencheng, received his fief in the fifth year of Heping.

sentences.zh: 少聰慧，年五歲，景穆崩，號哭不絕聲。

translations.literal: As a youth he was clever; at five, when Jingmu died, he wept without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Clever even as a boy, at five when Jingmu died he wept without stopping.

sentences.zh: 太武抱之泣曰：「汝何知而有成人意也！

translations.literal: Taiwu took him in his arms and wept, saying: "How can you know enough to have the mind of a grown man!
translations.idiomatic: Taiwu took him in his arms and wept. "How is it you already have a grown man's heart?

sentences.zh: 」獻文時，拜都督中外諸軍事、中都大官，聽訟，甚收時譽。

translations.literal: " Under Xianwen he was made commander of all military affairs within and without the court and Director of the Inner Palace at the Center, heard civil suits, and won great praise of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xianwen he commanded all armies at court and in the field, directed the Inner Palace at the Center, heard civil suits, and won wide renown.

sentences.zh: 及獻文欲禪位於京兆王子推，王公卿士莫敢先言。

translations.literal: When Xianwen wished to abdicate to Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao, kings, dukes, and grandees dared speak first of none.
translations.idiomatic: When Xianwen wished to abdicate to Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao, none among kings, dukes, and grandees dared speak first.

sentences.zh: 雲進曰：「父子相傳久矣，皇魏未之有革。

translations.literal: Yun advanced and said: "Father passing the throne to son has long been the way; since Imperial Wei rose there has been no change.
translations.idiomatic: Yun stepped forward. "Father passing rule to son is an ancient way; since Imperial Wei rose, that line has never been broken.

sentences.zh: 」太尉源賀又進以為不可，願思任城之言。

translations.literal: " Grand Commandant Yuan He also advanced and said it could not be done, and begged deep thought for the Prince of Rencheng's words.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Yuan He added that it could not be done and begged the throne to heed the Prince of Rencheng.

sentences.zh: 東陽西元丕等進曰：「皇太子雖聖德夙彰，然實沖幼。

translations.literal: Yuan Pi of Dongyang and others advanced and said: "The crown prince's sagely virtue was long manifest, yet in truth he is still very young.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Pi of Dongyang and others said, "The crown prince's virtue is plain, yet he is still a child.

sentences.zh: 陛下欲隆獨善，其若宗廟何？

translations.literal: Your Majesty wishes to exalt solitary goodness—what of the ancestral temples?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty seeks private ease—what becomes of the ancestral temples?

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「儲宮正統，群公相之，有何不可？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The heir's palace is orthodox; the lords assist him—what cannot be done?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The heir holds the orthodox line; the lords will assist him—what could be impossible?

sentences.zh: 」於是傳位孝文。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the throne passed to Emperor Xiaowen.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the throne passed to Emperor Xiaowen.

sentences.zh: 後蠕蠕犯塞，雲為中軍大都督，從獻文討之。

translations.literal: Later, when the Rouran raided the frontier, Yun was made Grand Commander of the Center Army and followed Xianwen to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When the Rouran raided the frontier Yun was made Grand Commander of the Center Army and followed Xianwen to war.

sentences.zh: 過大磧，雲曰：「夷狄之馬初不見武頭盾，若令此盾在前，破之必矣。

translations.literal: Crossing the Great Marsh, Yun said: "The barbarians' horses have never seen the Wu-head shield; if this shield is placed in front, breaking them is certain.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Great Marsh, Yun said, "Their horses have never seen the Wu-head shield; put it in front and we are sure to break them.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之，命敕勒首領，執手勞遣之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed this, ordered the Tiele chiefs, and grasped their hands in labor and send-off.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed, ordered the Tiele chiefs, and took their hands in farewell.

sentences.zh: 於是相率而歌，方駕而前。

translations.literal: Thereupon they sang in succession and drove forward in formation.
translations.idiomatic: They sang as one and drove forward in formation.

sentences.zh: 大破之，獲其凶首。

translations.literal: A great defeat was inflicted and their chieftains were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The army won a great victory and took their chieftains.

sentences.zh: 後仇池氐反，又命雲討平之。

translations.literal: Later the Di of Chouchi rebelled; Yun was again ordered to campaign and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chouchi Di rebelled he was again sent to campaign and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 除開府、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: He was removed and made commander with an open office and Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then given an open office and made inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 雲乙太妃蓋氏薨，表求解任。

translations.literal: When Yun's grand consort Lady Gai died, he memorialized asking to resign his post.
translations.idiomatic: When his grand consort Lady Gai died, Yun asked to resign his post.

sentences.zh: 獻文不許。

translations.literal: Xianwen did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianwen refused.

sentences.zh: 雲悲號動疾，乃許之。

translations.literal: Yun wailed until illness struck; only then was he allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Yun wailed until he fell ill; only then was he released.

sentences.zh: 性善撫接，深得徐方之心，為百姓所追戀，送遺錢貨，一無所受。

translations.literal: By nature he was good at comforting men; he won the hearts of Xu deeply, and the people clung to him, sending gifts of money and goods—all of which he refused.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at winning men and deeply won Xu; the people clung to him and sent money and goods, but he accepted none.

sentences.zh: 再遷冀州刺史，甚得下情。

translations.literal: Transferred again to Inspector of Jizhou, he won the lower ranks' hearts exceedingly.
translations.idiomatic: Made inspector of Jizhou, he won the common people's hearts even more.

sentences.zh: 於是合州請戶輸絹五尺、粟五升，以報雲恩。

translations.literal: Thereupon the whole province asked each household to submit five feet of silk and five sheng of grain to repay Yun's grace.
translations.idiomatic: The whole province then asked each household to give five feet of silk and five sheng of grain in thanks for Yun's grace.

sentences.zh: 孝文嘉之，詔宣告天下，使知勸勵。

translations.literal: Xiaowen praised this and issued an edict proclaimed throughout the realm to show encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowen praised it and proclaimed an edict through the realm as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 遷長安鎮都大將、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand General of Chang'an Garrison and Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to grand general of Chang'an Garrison and inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 雲廉謹自修，留心庶獄，挫抑豪強，劫盜止息，州人頌之者千餘人。

translations.literal: Yun cultivated himself with integrity and care, attended to common lawsuits, checked the powerful, and robbery ceased; more than a thousand in the province praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Yun lived with integrity, minded common lawsuits, checked the powerful, and robbery ceased; more than a thousand in the province praised him.

sentences.zh: 太和五年，薨於州，遺令薄葬，勿受贈襚，諸子奉遵其旨。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taihe he died in the province; he left orders for a plain burial and no funeral gifts; his sons all followed his will.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe year 5 he died in the province, ordering a plain burial and no funeral gifts; his sons obeyed.

sentences.zh: 諡曰康，陪葬雲中之金陵。

translations.literal: Posthumous title Kang; buried with honor at Jinling in Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Kang and buried with honor at Jinling in Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 長子澄，字道鏡，少好學，美鬢髮，善舉止，言辭清辯，響若縣鐘。

translations.literal: His eldest son Cheng, styled Daojing, loved learning from youth, had fine hair and beard, graceful bearing, clear and eloquent speech, a voice like a suspended bell.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Cheng, styled Daojing, loved learning from youth, had fine hair and beard, graceful bearing, and a clear, bell-like voice.

sentences.zh: 康王薨，居喪以孝聞。

translations.literal: When Prince Kang died, his mourning was famed for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Kang died, his mourning was famed for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 襲封，加征北大將軍。

translations.literal: He inherited the title and was further made Grand General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the title and was further made Grand General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 以氏羌反叛，除征南大將軍、梁州刺史。

translations.literal: Because the Di and Qiang rebelled, he was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Di and Qiang rebelled he was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and inspector of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 文明太后引見誡厲之，顧謂中書令李沖曰：「此兒風神吐發，當為宗室領袖，是行當不辱命，我不妄也。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Wenming received him and admonished him, turning to Director of the Secretariat Li Chong and saying: "This boy's spirit shines forth; he will be a leader among the imperial kin. On this mission he will not disgrace his charge—I do not speak idly.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Wenming received and warned him, then told Director of the Secretariat Li Chong, "This boy's spirit shines; he will lead the imperial kin. He will not disgrace this mission—I do not speak idly.

sentences.zh: 」澄至州，誘導懷附，西南款順。

translations.literal: " At the province he guided and won attachment; the southwest submitted in good faith.
translations.idiomatic: At the province he guided and won men; the southwest submitted in good faith.

sentences.zh: 加侍中，賜衣一襲，乘黃馬一匹，以旌其能。

translations.literal: He was added Palace Attendant, granted one suit of robes and one yellow horse, to mark his ability.
translations.idiomatic: He was made palace attendant, granted a suit of robes and a yellow horse, to mark his ability.

sentences.zh: 轉開府、徐州刺史，甚著聲績。

translations.literal: Transferred to commander with an open office and Inspector of Xuzhou, he won great fame and achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Made commander with an open office and inspector of Xuzhou, he won great fame and achievement.

sentences.zh: 朝京師，引見於皇信堂。

translations.literal: Coming to the capital he was received in the Hall of Imperial Trust.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital he was received in the Hall of Imperial Trust.

sentences.zh: 孝文詔澄曰：「昔鄭子產鑄刑書而晉叔向非之。

translations.literal: Xiaowen said to Cheng: "Long ago Zichan of Zheng cast the penal code and Shu Xiang of Jin opposed it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowen said to Cheng, "Long ago Zichan of Zheng cast the penal code and Shu Xiang of Jin opposed it.

sentences.zh: 此二人皆賢士，得失竟誰？

translations.literal: Both were worthy men—who in the end was right?
translations.idiomatic: Both were worthy—who was right in the end?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「鄭國寡弱，攝于強鄰，人情去就，非刑莫制，故鑄刑書以示威。

translations.literal: He replied: "Zheng was few and weak, subject to a strong neighbor; the people's going and staying could not be governed without penal law, so he cast the code to show authority.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Zheng was few and weak, subject to a strong neighbor; the people's going and staying needed penal law, so he cast the code to show authority.

sentences.zh: 雖乖古式，合今權道。

translations.literal: Though it departed from ancient form, it fit the expedient of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Though it departed from antiquity, it fit the age's expedient.

sentences.zh: 」帝方革變，深善其對，笑曰：「任城當欲為魏子產也。

translations.literal: The emperor was then reforming institutions and deeply approved his answer, smiling: "Prince of Rencheng wishes to be Wei's Zichan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was reforming institutions and deeply approved, smiling, "Prince of Rencheng would be Wei's Zichan.

sentences.zh: 朕方創改朝制，當與任城共萬世之功。

translations.literal: I am now creating new court institutions and shall share ten-thousand-year achievement with Prince of Rencheng.
translations.idiomatic: I am now creating new court institutions and shall share enduring achievement with Prince of Rencheng.

sentences.zh: 」後徵為中書令，改授尚書令。

translations.literal: Later he was summoned as Director of the Secretariat and changed to Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was summoned as director of the Secretariat and then director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 齊庾蓽來朝，見澄音韻遒雅，風儀秀逸，謂主客郎張彝曰：「往魏任城以武著稱，今魏任城乃以文見美也。」

translations.literal: Qi's Yu Bi came to court; seeing Cheng's voice resonant and elegant, his bearing refined, he told Chief of Guests Zhang Yi: "Formerly Wei's Prince of Rencheng was famed for martial prowess; now Wei's Prince of Rencheng is praised for letters."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bi of Qi came to court; seeing Cheng's resonant voice and refined bearing, he told Chief of Guests Zhang Yi, "Once Wei's Prince of Rencheng was famed for war; now he is praised for letters."

sentences.zh: 時詔延四廟之子，下逮玄孫之胄，申宗宴於皇信堂。

translations.literal: At that time an edict extended the four temples' sons down to great-great-grandsons' descendants and held a clan feast in the Hall of Imperial Trust.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then gathered sons of the four temples down to great-great-grandsons for a clan feast in the Hall of Imperial Trust.

sentences.zh: 不以爵秩為列，悉序昭穆為次，用家人之禮。

translations.literal: They were not ranked by title but all ordered by zhao and mu sequence, using family rites.
translations.idiomatic: They were not ranked by title but ordered by zhao and mu, with family rites.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「行禮已畢、欲令宗室各言其志，可率賦詩。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The rites are finished; I wish each of the clan to speak his heart—compose poems as you will.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The rites are done; let each of the clan speak his heart—compose poems as you will.

sentences.zh: 」特命澄為七言連韻，與孝文往復賭賽，遂至極歡，際夜乃罷。

translations.literal: He specially ordered Cheng to make linked seven-character rhyme; he and Xiaowen wagered back and forth until utmost joy, and only at night did they stop.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Cheng to make linked seven-character rhyme; he and Xiaowen wagered until joy peaked and night ended the feast.

sentences.zh: 後帝外示南討，意在謀遷，齊于明堂左個。

translations.literal: Later the emperor outwardly showed a southern campaign but inwardly meant to plan the move, with Qi at the left bay of the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Later he outwardly showed a southern campaign but meant to plan the move, with Qi at the Bright Hall's left bay.

sentences.zh: 詔太常卿王諶，親令龜卜易筮南伐之事，其兆遇《革》。

translations.literal: He ordered Grand Master of Rites Wang Chen in person to divine by tortoise and yarrow the matter of campaigning south; the omen met Hexagram Ge.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Grand Master of Rites Wang Chen to divine by tortoise and yarrow a southern campaign; the omen was Ge.

sentences.zh: 澄進曰：「《易》言革者更也，將欲革君臣之命，湯、武得之為吉。

translations.literal: Cheng advanced and said: "The Changes says Ge means change—it will change the mandate between ruler and subject; Tang and Wu obtained it as auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng advanced. "The Changes says Ge means change—it would change the mandate between ruler and subject; Tang and Wu found that auspicious.

sentences.zh: 陛下帝有天下，今日卜征，不得雲革命，未可全為吉也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty already holds all under heaven; to divine a campaign today cannot be called revolution in full—this cannot be wholly auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty already holds the realm; to divine a campaign today cannot be wholly revolution—this cannot be wholly auspicious.

sentences.zh: 」帝厲聲曰：「此象雲大人武變，何言不吉也！

translations.literal: The emperor said sternly: "This image says the great man changes by force—how is it not auspicious!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said sternly, "This image says the great man changes by force—how is it not auspicious?

sentences.zh: 」車駕還宮，便召澄，未及升階，遙謂曰：「向者之《革》，今更欲論之。

translations.literal: The carriage returned to the palace and Cheng was summoned; before he mounted the steps the emperor called from afar: "The Ge just now—I wish to discuss it again.
translations.idiomatic: The carriage returned and Cheng was summoned; before he mounted the steps Xiaowen called, "That Ge just now—I wish to discuss it again.

sentences.zh: 明堂之忿，懼眾人競言，沮我大計，故厲色怖文武耳。

translations.literal: My anger at the Bright Hall was fear that the crowd would all speak and thwart my great plan, so I showed a stern face to frighten civil and military alike.
translations.idiomatic: My anger at the Bright Hall was fear the crowd would thwart my great plan, so I showed a stern face to frighten court and army.

sentences.zh: 」乃獨謂澄曰：「國家興自北土，徙居平城，雖富有四海，文軌未一。

translations.literal: Then he spoke to Cheng alone: "The state rose from the northern land and dwelt at Pingcheng; though rich in the four seas, culture and the cart-track were not one.
translations.idiomatic: Then he spoke to Cheng alone. "The state rose in the north and dwelt at Pingcheng; though it held the four seas, culture and the cart-track were not one.

sentences.zh: 此間用武之地，非可興文。

translations.literal: This region is a field for military use—not where civilization is raised.
translations.idiomatic: This is a field for war—not where civilization is raised.

sentences.zh: 崤函帝宅，河洛王裏，因茲大舉，光宅中原，任城意以為何如？

translations.literal: The imperial seat lies between Xiao and Han; the royal capital is in He and Luo—by this great move to glorify the central plain, what does Prince of Rencheng think?
translations.idiomatic: Between Xiao and Han lies the imperial seat; He and Luo are the royal capital—by this great move to glorify the central plain, what does Prince of Rencheng think?

sentences.zh: 」澄深贊成其事。

translations.literal: Cheng deeply approved the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng deeply approved.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「任城便是我之子房。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Prince of Rencheng is my Zifang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Prince of Rencheng is my Zifang.

sentences.zh: 」加撫軍大將軍、太子少保，又兼尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: He was added Grand General Who Pacifies the Army and Junior Tutor of the Heir, and also concurrently Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was added Grand General Who Pacifies the Army and junior tutor of the heir, and also left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 及車駕幸洛陽，定遷都之策，詔澄馳驛向北，問彼百司，論擇可否。

translations.literal: When the carriage reached Luoyang and settled the plan to move the capital, Cheng was ordered to ride post-horses north and ask the hundred offices there, debating what could or could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage reached Luoyang and settled the capital move, Cheng was ordered to ride post north and ask the hundred offices whether it could be done.

sentences.zh: 曰：「近論《革》，今真所謂革也。

translations.literal: He said: "We lately discussed Ge; now this is truly what is called Ge.
translations.idiomatic: He said, "We lately discussed Ge; now this is truly Ge.

sentences.zh: 」澄既至代都，眾聞遷詔，莫不驚駭。

translations.literal: When Cheng reached the northern capital, all who heard the move edict were startled.
translations.idiomatic: At the northern capital all who heard the move edict were startled.

sentences.zh: 澄援引今古，徐以曉之，眾乃開伏。

translations.literal: Cheng cited present and past and slowly enlightened them; the crowd then opened and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng cited present and past and slowly enlightened them; the crowd then submitted.

sentences.zh: 遂南馳還報，會車駕於滑台。

translations.literal: He galloped south to report and met the carriage at Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: He galloped south to report and met the carriage at Huatai.

sentences.zh: 帝大悅曰：「若非任城，朕事業不得就也。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and said: "Had it not been for Prince of Rencheng, my undertaking would not have been achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased. "Without Prince of Rencheng my undertaking would not have been achieved.

sentences.zh: 」從幸鄴宮。

translations.literal: He followed in attendance at the Ye palace.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in attendance at the Ye palace.

sentences.zh: 除吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was made director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 及車駕自代北巡，留澄銓簡舊臣。

translations.literal: When the carriage toured north from the northern capital, Cheng was left to grade the old officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage toured north from the northern capital, Cheng was left to grade the old officials.

sentences.zh: 初，魏自公侯以下，動有萬數，冗散無事。

translations.literal: At first, from dukes and marquises down, Wei had tens of thousands idle and scattered without duties.
translations.idiomatic: At first, from dukes and marquises down, tens of thousands in Wei were idle and without duties.

sentences.zh: 澄品為三等，量其優劣，盡其能否之用，咸無怨者。

translations.literal: Cheng graded them in three ranks, measured excellence and defect, and used each to the limit of ability—none bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng graded them in three ranks, measured each by ability, and used all without resentment.

sentences.zh: 駕還洛京，復兼右僕射。

translations.literal: When the carriage returned to Luoyang he again held the right vice directorship concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage returned to Luoyang he again held the right vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 帝至北芒，遂幸洪池，命澄侍升龍舟。

translations.literal: The emperor reached North Mang and then visited Hong Pool, ordering Cheng to attend aboard the dragon boat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reached North Mang and visited Hong Pool, ordering Cheng to attend aboard the dragon boat.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕昨夜夢一老公，拜立路左，雲晉侍中嵇紹，故此奉迎，神爽卑懼，似有求焉。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Last night I dreamed an old man bowing by the road, saying he was Jin's Palace Attendant Ji Shao—therefore he came to meet me; my spirit was low and fearful, as though he had a request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Last night I dreamed an old man bowing by the road, saying he was Jin's Palace Attendant Ji Shao come to meet me; my spirit was low and fearful, as though he had a request.

sentences.zh: 」澄曰：「陛下經殷墟而吊比干，至洛陽而遺嵇紹，當是希恩而感夢。

translations.literal: Cheng said: "Your Majesty passed Yin's ruins and mourned Bi Gan, reached Luoyang and met Ji Shao in dream—this must be longing for grace that moved the dream.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "Your Majesty mourned Bi Gan at Yin's ruins and met Ji Shao at Luoyang in dream—longing for grace must have moved the dream.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「朕既有此夢，或如任城所言。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Since I had this dream, perhaps it is as Prince of Rencheng said.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Since I had this dream, perhaps it is as Prince of Rencheng said.

sentences.zh: 」於是求其兆域，遣使弔祭焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon his tomb domain was sought and envoys sent to mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: His tomb domain was sought and envoys sent to mourn and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 齊明帝既廢弑自立，其雍州刺史曹武請以襄陽內附。

translations.literal: After Qi's Emperor Ming had deposed and murdered his lord to establish himself, Qi's Inspector of Yongzhou Cao Wu asked to bring Xiangyang within.
translations.idiomatic: After Qi's Emperor Ming deposed and murdered his lord, Cao Wu, inspector of Yongzhou, asked to bring Xiangyang within.

sentences.zh: 車駕將自赴之，引澄及咸陽王禧、彭城王勰、司徒馮誕、司空穆亮、鎮南李沖等議之。

translations.literal: The carriage was about to go in person; Cheng and Prince of Xianyang Xi, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, Director of the Secretariat Feng Yan, Minister of Works Mu Liang, and Grand General Who Guards the South Li Chong were summoned to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The carriage was about to go in person; Cheng, Prince of Xianyang Xi, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, Director of the Secretariat Feng Yan, Minister of Works Mu Liang, and Grand General Who Guards the South Li Chong were summoned to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 禧等或云宜行，或言宜止。

translations.literal: Xi and the rest said some that one should go, some that one should stop.
translations.idiomatic: Some said go, some said stop.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「眾人意見不等，宜有客主，共相起發。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The crowd's views differ; there should be guest and host to stir each other.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Views differ; let guest and host stir each other.

sentences.zh: 任城與鎮南為應留之議，朕當為宜行之論。

translations.literal: Prince of Rencheng and Grand General Who Guards the South argue to stay; I shall argue to go.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Rencheng and Li Chong argue to stay; I shall argue to go.

sentences.zh: 諸公坐聽，長者從之。

translations.literal: You all sit and listen; the elder side prevails.
translations.idiomatic: You all sit and listen; the elder side prevails.

sentences.zh: 」於是帝往復數交，駕遂南征，不從澄及李沖等言。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor went back and forth several rounds; the carriage then marched south, not following Cheng and Li Chong's words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor debated back and forth; the carriage then marched south, not following Cheng and Li Chong.

sentences.zh: 後從徵至縣瓠，以疾篤還京。

translations.literal: Later, following the campaign to Xianhu, he returned to the capital because illness grew severe.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on campaign at Xianhu, severe illness made him return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 車駕還洛，引見王公侍臣于清徽堂。

translations.literal: When the carriage returned to Luo, kings, dukes, and attendant ministers were received at the Clear Splendor Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage returned to Luo, kings, dukes, and ministers were received at the Clear Splendor Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此堂成來，未與王公行宴樂之禮。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Since this hall was completed I have not held feast and music with kings and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Since this hall was finished I have not feasted with kings and dukes.

sentences.zh: 今與諸賢，欲無高而不升，無小而不入。

translations.literal: Today with you worthies I wish none high not to ascend, none small not to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Today with you worthies I wish none too high to ascend, none too small to enter.

sentences.zh: 」因之流化渠。

translations.literal: Thereupon they followed the Transforming Flow channel.
translations.idiomatic: They followed the Transforming Flow channel.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此曲水者，取乾道曲成，萬物無滯。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This winding water takes the meaning of Qian's way curving to completion—ten thousand things without stagnation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This winding water takes Qian's way curving to completion—ten thousand things without stagnation.

sentences.zh: 」次之洗煩池。

translations.literal: Next they reached the Wash-Weariness Pool.
translations.idiomatic: Next they reached the Wash-Weariness Pool.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此池亦有嘉魚。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This pool also has fine fish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This pool also has fine fish.

sentences.zh: 」澄曰：「所謂'魚在在藻，有頒其首。

translations.literal: Cheng said: "As the ode says, 'Fish there in the weeds, with heads well shown.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "As the ode says, 'Fish there in the weeds, with heads well shown.'

sentences.zh: '」帝曰：「且取'王在靈沼，於牣魚躍。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Then take 'The king is at the Spirit Marsh; how the fish leap in multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Then take 'The king is at the Spirit Marsh; how the fish leap in multitudes.'

sentences.zh: '」次之觀德殿。

translations.literal: Next they reached the View-Virtue Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Next they reached the View-Virtue Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「射以觀德，故遂命之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Archery is to view virtue—therefore it was so named.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Archery is to view virtue—therefore the name.

sentences.zh: 」次之凝閑堂。

translations.literal: Next they reached the Serene-Leisure Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Next they reached the Serene-Leisure Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此堂取夫子閒居之義。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This hall takes the Master's at-ease meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This hall takes the Master's at-ease meaning.

sentences.zh: 不可縱奢以忘儉，自安以忘危，故此堂後作茅茨堂。

translations.literal: One must not indulge luxury and forget frugality, settle in ease and forget peril—therefore behind this hall the Thatched Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: One must not indulge luxury and forget frugality, settle in ease and forget peril—therefore behind it stands the Thatched Hall.

sentences.zh: 」謂李沖曰：「此東曰步元廡，西曰遊凱廡。

translations.literal: He told Li Chong: "East of here is the Pace-Origin Gallery; west is the Roaming-Triumph Gallery.
translations.idiomatic: He told Li Chong, "East is the Pace-Origin Gallery; west is the Roaming-Triumph Gallery.

sentences.zh: 此坐雖無唐堯之君，卿等當無愧於元、凱。

translations.literal: Though we lack a ruler like Tang Yao, you should not be shamed before Yuan and Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Though we lack a ruler like Tang Yao, you should not be shamed before Yuan and Kai.

sentences.zh: 」沖對曰：「臣既遭唐堯之君，敢辭元、凱之譽？

translations.literal: Chong replied: "Your servant has met a ruler like Tang Yao—how dare I decline Yuan and Kai's praise?
translations.idiomatic: Chong replied, "Your servant has met a ruler like Tang Yao—how dare I decline Yuan and Kai's praise?

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「光景垂落，朕同宗有載考之義，卿等將出，何得默爾德音。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Light is falling; I share with the clan the meaning of keeping vigil for elders—you are about to leave; how can you be silent in virtue's voice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Light is falling; I share with the clan vigil for elders—you are about to leave; how can you be silent?

sentences.zh: 」即命黃門侍郎崔光、郭祚、通直郎刑巒、崔休等賦詩言志。

translations.literal: He at once ordered Palace Attendant Cui Guang, Guo Zuo, Unimpeded Attendant Xing Luan, Cui Xiu, and others to compose poems declaring their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Palace Attendant Cui Guang, Guo Zuo, Unimpeded Attendant Xing Luan, Cui Xiu, and others to compose poems.

sentences.zh: 燭至，公卿辭退，李沖再拜上于萬歲壽。

translations.literal: When candles came, dukes and ministers withdrew; Li Chong bowed again and offered long life.
translations.idiomatic: When candles came, dukes and ministers withdrew; Li Chong bowed again and offered long life.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿等以燭至致辭，復獻于萬壽，朕報卿以《南山》之詩。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "You take candle's coming as leave and again offer long life; I repay you with the ode Southern Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You take the candle as leave and again offer long life; I repay you with Southern Mountains.

sentences.zh: 」乃曰：「燭至辭退，庶姓之禮；

translations.literal: He then said: "Candle comes and guests withdraw—that is commoners' rite;
translations.idiomatic: He said, "Candle comes and guests withdraw—that is commoners' rite;

sentences.zh: 在夜載考，宗族之義。

translations.literal: to keep vigil at night is the clan's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: to keep vigil at night is the clan's meaning.

sentences.zh: 卿等且還，朕與諸王宗室欲成此夜飲。

translations.literal: You may return; I with the kings and clan wish to finish this night's drinking.
translations.idiomatic: Return; I with the kings and clan will finish this night's drinking.

sentences.zh: 」後坐公事免官。

translations.literal: Later he was removed from office for public affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was removed from office over public affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he held the Ministry of Personnel concurrently again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he held the Ministry of Personnel again.

sentences.zh: 恆州刺史穆泰在州謀反，授澄節，銅武、竹使符，禦仗左右，仍行恆州事。

translations.literal: Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai plotted rebellion in the province; Cheng was given the tally, bronze martial and bamboo civil tallies, imperial guards at the side, and still conducted Hengzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tai, inspector of Hengzhou, plotted rebellion; Cheng was given tallies, imperial guards, and still ran Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 行達雁門，遣書侍御史李煥先赴。

translations.literal: Reaching Yanmen he sent Palace Attendant Li Huan ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Yanmen he sent Palace Attendant Li Huan ahead.

sentences.zh: 至即禽泰，窮其党與，罪人皆得。

translations.literal: On arrival he seized Tai at once and exhausted his faction; all culprits were taken.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he seized Tai and exhausted his faction; all culprits were taken.

sentences.zh: 钜鹿公陸睿、安樂侯元隆等百餘人並獄禁。

translations.literal: Duke of Julu Lu Rui, Marquis of Anle Yuan Long, and more than a hundred others were all imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Julu Lu Rui, Marquis of Anle Yuan Long, and more than a hundred others were imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 具狀表聞。

translations.literal: The full report was memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: The full report was memorialized.

sentences.zh: 帝覽表，乃大悅曰：「我任城可謂社稷臣，正復皋陶斷獄，豈能過之？

translations.literal: The emperor read the memorial and was greatly pleased: "My Prince of Rencheng may be called a pillar of the state; even Gao Yao judging cases could not surpass this!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it and was greatly pleased. "My Prince of Rencheng is a pillar of the state; even Gao Yao judging cases could not surpass this!

sentences.zh: 」顧咸陽王等曰：「汝等脫當其處，不能辦此也。

translations.literal: He turned to Prince of Xianyang and the rest: "If you were in his place you could not have managed this.
translations.idiomatic: He turned to Prince of Xianyang and the rest. "In his place you could not have managed this.

sentences.zh: 」車駕尋幸平城。

translations.literal: The carriage soon visited Pingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The carriage soon visited Pingcheng.

sentences.zh: 勞澄，引見逆徒，無一人稱枉。

translations.literal: Cheng was rewarded with audience; the rebels were led before him and not one claimed injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was rewarded with audience; rebels were led before him and not one claimed injustice.

sentences.zh: 時人莫不歎之。

translations.literal: At the time none did not sigh in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: At the time none did not sigh in admiration.

sentences.zh: 帝謂左右曰：「必也無訟，今日見之。

translations.literal: The emperor told those at his side: "Confucius said there would be no lawsuits—today I have seen it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told those at his side, "Confucius said there would be no lawsuits—today I have seen it.

sentences.zh: 」以澄正尚書。

translations.literal: Cheng was made regular director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was made regular director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 車駕南伐，留澄居守，復兼右僕射。

translations.literal: On the southern campaign the carriage left Cheng to guard the capital, again with right vice directorship concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On the southern campaign the carriage left Cheng to guard the capital, again with right vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 澄表請以國秩一歲租帛，助供軍資，詔受其半。

translations.literal: Cheng memorialized asking to give one year's rent in silk of the state fief for army supplies; an edict accepted half.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng asked to give one year's state-fief rent in silk for the army; an edict took half.

sentences.zh: 帝復幸鄴。

translations.literal: The emperor again visited Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again visited Ye.

sentences.zh: 見公卿曰：「朕昨入城，見車上婦人冠帽而著小襦襖者，尚書何為不察？

translations.literal: Seeing dukes and ministers he said: "Yesterday entering the city I saw women in carts wearing caps and small jackets—why did the Masters of Writing not investigate?
translations.idiomatic: Seeing ministers he said, "Yesterday entering the city I saw women in carts wearing caps and small jackets—why did the Masters of Writing not investigate?

sentences.zh: 」澄曰：「著者猶少。

translations.literal: Cheng said: "Those who wear them are still few.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "Those who wear them are still few.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「任城欲令全著乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Does Prince of Rencheng wish all to wear them?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Does Prince of Rencheng wish all to wear them?

sentences.zh: 一言可以喪邦，其斯之謂。

translations.literal: One word can lose a state—this is what is meant.
translations.idiomatic: One word can lose a state—this is what is meant.

sentences.zh: 可命史官書之。

translations.literal: Order the historiographers to record it.
translations.idiomatic: Order the historiographers to record it.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「王者不降佐於蒼昊，拔才而用之。

translations.literal: He also said: "A king does not lower himself to the blue heavens but raises talent and employs it.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "A king does not lower himself to the blue heavens but raises talent and employs it.

sentences.zh: 朕失于舉人，任一群婦女輩，當更銓簡耳。

translations.literal: I failed in choosing men and put a crowd of women in charge—I must grade again.
translations.idiomatic: I failed in choosing men and put women in charge—I must grade again.

sentences.zh: 任城在省，為舉天下綱維，為當署事而已？

translations.literal: Prince of Rencheng is in the capital as the realm's great warp—does he only sign documents?
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Rencheng is in the capital as the realm's warp—does he only sign documents?

sentences.zh: 」澄曰：「臣實署事而已。

translations.literal: Cheng said: "Your servant truly only signs documents.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "Your servant truly only signs documents.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「如此，便一令史足矣，何待任城？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If so, one clerk suffices—why wait for Prince of Rencheng?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If so, one clerk suffices—why wait for Prince of Rencheng?

sentences.zh: 」尋除尚書左僕射，從駕南伐。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and followed the carriage on the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made left vice director and followed the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 孝文崩，受顧命。

translations.literal: When Xiaowen died he received the final charge.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaowen died he received the final charge.

sentences.zh: 宣武初，有降人嚴叔懋告尚書令王肅遣孔思達潛通齊國，為叛逆。

translations.literal: At the start of Emperor Xuanwu, a surrendered man Yan Shumao reported Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Su had sent Kong Sida in secret contact with Qi as rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Xuanwu, a surrendered man Yan Shumao reported Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Su sent Kong Sida in secret contact with Qi as rebellion.

sentences.zh: 澄信之，乃表肅將叛，輒下禁止。

translations.literal: Cheng believed it and memorialized that Su was about to rebel, and at once forbade and detained him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng believed it and memorialized that Su would rebel, and at once detained him.

sentences.zh: 咸陽、北海二王奏澄擅禁宰輔，免官還第。

translations.literal: Princes of Xianyang and Beihai memorialized that Cheng had detained a chief minister on his own authority; he was removed and returned to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Princes of Xianyang and Beihai memorialized that Cheng detained a chief minister on his own; he was removed to his residence.

sentences.zh: 尋除開府、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was made commander with an open office and Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made commander with an open office and inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 下車封孫叔敖之墓，毀蔣子文之廟；

translations.literal: On taking his post he sealed Sun Shuao's tomb and destroyed Jiang Ziwen's shrine;
translations.idiomatic: On taking his post he sealed Sun Shuao's tomb and destroyed Jiang Ziwen's shrine;

sentences.zh: 上表請修復皇宗之學，開四門之教。

translations.literal: he memorialized asking to restore the Imperial Clan School and open the Four Gates teaching.
translations.idiomatic: he memorialized to restore the Imperial Clan School and open the Four Gates teaching.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed.

sentences.zh: 先是，朝議有南伐之計，以蕭寶夤為東揚州刺史，據東城；

translations.literal: Earlier court discussion had a plan for southern campaign; Xiao Baoyin was made Inspector of Eastern Yangzhou, holding the eastern city;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the court planned southern campaign; Xiao Baoyin was made inspector of Eastern Yangzhou, holding the eastern city;

sentences.zh: 陳伯之為江州刺史，戍陽石。

translations.literal: Chen Bozhi was made Inspector of Jiangzhou, garrisoning Yangshi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bozhi was made inspector of Jiangzhou, garrisoning Yangshi.

sentences.zh: 以澄總督二鎮，授之節度。

translations.literal: Cheng was made overall commander of the two garrisons and given their regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was made overall commander of the two garrisons with full regulation.

sentences.zh: 澄於是遣統軍傅豎眼、王神念等進次大峴、東關、九山、淮陵，皆分部諸將，倍道據之。

translations.literal: Cheng then sent Commander Fu Shuyan, Wang Shennian, and others to advance to Da Xian, Dongguan, Jiushan, and Huailing, each with generals in division, doubling pace to seize them.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng sent Commander Fu Shuyan, Wang Shennian, and others to Da Xian, Dongguan, Jiushan, and Huailing, generals in division at double pace.

sentences.zh: 澄總勒大眾，絡繹相接，所在克捷，詔書褒美。

translations.literal: Cheng overall led the great host in continuous array; wherever he went he conquered; edicts praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng led the great host in continuous array; wherever he went he conquered; edicts praised him.

sentences.zh: 既而遇雨，淮水暴長，澄引歸壽春。

translations.literal: Then rain came and the Huai rose in flood; Cheng withdrew to Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Then rain came and the Huai flooded; Cheng withdrew to Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 還既狼狽，失兵四千餘人。

translations.literal: The return was disordered; more than four thousand soldiers were lost.
translations.idiomatic: The return was disordered; more than four thousand soldiers were lost.

sentences.zh: 澄頻表解州，帝不許。

translations.literal: Cheng repeatedly memorialized asking to resign the province; the emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng repeatedly asked to resign the province; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 有司奏奪其開府，又降三階。

translations.literal: The relevant office memorialized to strip his open office; he was also demoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office memorialized to strip his open office; he was demoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 轉鎮北大將軍、定州刺史。

translations.literal: Transferred to Grand General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Grand General Who Guards the North and inspector of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，百姓每有橫調，恆煩苦之。

translations.literal: At first the people had many forced levies and constantly suffered.
translations.idiomatic: At first the people had many forced levies and constantly suffered.

sentences.zh: 前後牧守未能蠲除，澄多所省減。

translations.literal: Former inspectors and governors could not remove them; Cheng removed many.
translations.idiomatic: Former inspectors could not remove them; Cheng removed many.

sentences.zh: 又明黜陟賞罰之法，表減公園之地以給無業貧人，布絹不任衣者禁不聽造，百姓欣賴焉。

translations.literal: He also clarified the law of promotion, demotion, reward, and punishment, memorialized to reduce parklands for landless poor, and forbade making cloth and silk unfit for clothing—the people rejoiced and relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: He clarified promotion and punishment, reduced parklands for the landless poor, and forbade cloth unfit for clothing—the people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 母孟太妃薨，居喪過毀，當世稱之。

translations.literal: When Grand Consort Meng died his mourning exceeded measure; the age praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Consort Meng died his mourning exceeded measure; the age praised him.

sentences.zh: 服闋，除太子太保。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was made junior tutor of the heir.

sentences.zh: 時高肇當朝，猜忌賢戚。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Zhao held court and was jealous of worthy kin.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zhao then held court and was jealous of worthy kin.

sentences.zh: 澄為肇間構，常恐不全，乃終日昏飲，以示荒敗。

translations.literal: Cheng was slandered by Zhao's intrigues and constantly feared he would not survive, so all day he drank in stupor to show ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was slandered by Zhao and constantly feared for his life, so he drank all day to show ruin.

sentences.zh: 所作詭越，時謂為狂。

translations.literal: What he did was bizarre and excessive; the age called him mad.
translations.idiomatic: What he did was bizarre; the age called him mad.

sentences.zh: 宣武夜崩，時事倉卒，高肇擁兵於外。

translations.literal: When Xuanwu died suddenly affairs were rushed; Gao Zhao held troops outside.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanwu died suddenly affairs were rushed; Gao Zhao held troops outside.

sentences.zh: 明帝沖幼，朝野不安。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming was young; court and countryside were unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming was young; court and countryside were unsettled.

sentences.zh: 澄雖疏斥，而朝望所屬。

translations.literal: Though Cheng was kept at a distance, court hope rested on him.
translations.idiomatic: Though kept at a distance, court hope rested on Cheng.

sentences.zh: 領軍於忠、侍中崔光等奏澄為尚書令，於是眾心欣服。

translations.literal: Commander of the Guards Yu Zhong, Palace Attendant Cui Guang, and others memorialized Cheng as Director of the Masters of Writing; the crowd's hearts were then pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of the Guards Yu Zhong, Palace Attendant Cui Guang, and others memorialized Cheng as director; hearts were pleased.

sentences.zh: 尋遷司空，加侍中，俄詔領尚書令。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Minister of Works with palace attendance; soon an edict had him lead the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was minister of works with palace attendance; soon an edict had him lead the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 登表上《皇誥宗制》並《訓詁》各一卷，欲太后覽之，思勸誡之益。

translations.literal: He submitted to the throne Imperial Instructions on Clan Regulation and Glosses, one scroll each, wishing the empress dowager to read them and think on admonition's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted Imperial Instructions on Clan Regulation and Glosses, one scroll each, for the empress dowager's admonition.

sentences.zh: 又奏利國濟人所宜振舉者十條：一曰律度量衡，公私不同，所宜一之；

translations.literal: He also memorialized ten items fitting the state and benefiting the people: first, laws, measures, and scales differ between public and private and should be unified;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized ten items for state and people: first, laws, measures, and scales differ public and private and should be one;

sentences.zh: 二曰宜興學校，以明黜陟之法；

translations.literal: second, schools should be raised to clarify promotion and demotion;
translations.idiomatic: second, raise schools to clarify promotion and demotion;

sentences.zh: 三曰宜興滅繼絕，各舉所知；

translations.literal: third, extinct lines should be continued, each recommending what he knows;
translations.idiomatic: third, continue extinct lines, each recommending what he knows;

sentences.zh: 四曰五調之外，一不煩人，任人之力，不過三日；

translations.literal: fourth, beyond the five levies, nothing should trouble the people; use of men's strength should not exceed three days;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, beyond the five levies nothing should trouble the people; labor should not exceed three days;

sentences.zh: 五曰臨人之官，皆須黜陟，以旌賞罰；

translations.literal: fifth, officials over the people must be promoted or demoted to mark reward and punishment;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, officials must be promoted or demoted to mark reward and punishment;

sentences.zh: 六曰逃亡代輸，去來年久者，若非伎作，任聽即住；

translations.literal: sixth, for fugitives who pay substitute tax, if away many years and not artisans, let them stay where they are;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, fugitives paying substitute tax, if away years and not artisans, let them stay;

sentences.zh: 七曰邊兵逃走，或實陷沒，皆須精檢，三長及近親，若實隱之，征其代輸，不隱勿論；

translations.literal: seventh, frontier soldiers who flee, or truly fall in battle, must be closely checked; if the three chiefs and near kin truly hide them, collect substitute tax—if not hidden, do not punish;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, fleeing frontier soldiers or those truly lost must be checked; if three chiefs and kin hide them, collect substitute tax—if not hidden, do not punish;

sentences.zh: 八曰工商世業之戶，復征租調，無以堪濟，今請免之，使專其業；

translations.literal: eighth, artisan and merchant hereditary households again pay rent and levy and cannot bear it—now ask exemption so they may keep their trades;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, artisan and merchant households again pay rent and cannot bear it—ask exemption so they keep their trades;

sentences.zh: 九曰三長禁奸，不得隔越相領，戶不滿者，隨近併合；

translations.literal: ninth, the three chiefs forbid crime and must not oversee across lines; households not full should be merged with the nearest;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, three chiefs forbid crime and must not oversee across lines; short households merge with the nearest;

sentences.zh: 十曰羽林武賁，邊方有事，暫可赴戰，常戍宜遣番兵代之。

translations.literal: tenth, armored guards and martial cadets—when the frontier has affairs they may go to battle for a time; regular garrison should send rotating troops in replacement.
translations.idiomatic: tenth, armored guards—when the frontier has affairs they may fight for a time; regular garrison should send rotating troops.

sentences.zh: 靈太后下其奏，百僚議之，事有同否。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling sent down his memorial; the hundred offices deliberated; matters had agreement and disagreement.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling sent down his memorial; offices deliberated; some agreed, some not.

sentences.zh: 時四中郎將兵數寡弱，不足以襟帶京師。

translations.literal: At the time the four central commanders' troops were few and weak, insufficient to gird the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The four central commanders' troops were few, insufficient to gird the capital.

sentences.zh: 澄奏宜以東中帶滎陽郡，南中帶魯陽郡，西中帶恆農郡，北中帶河內郡，選二品、三品親賢兼稱者居之。

translations.literal: Cheng memorialized that the eastern center should hold Yingyang commandery, the southern Luoyang, the western Hengnong, the northern Henei, choosing second- and third-rank kin both noble and worthy to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng memorialized the eastern center hold Yingyang, southern Luoyang, western Hengnong, northern Henei, with worthy kin of second and third rank.

sentences.zh: 省非急之作，配以強兵。

translations.literal: Non-urgent work should be cut and strong troops attached.
translations.idiomatic: Cut non-urgent work and attach strong troops.

sentences.zh: 如此則深根固本，強幹弱枝之義也。

translations.literal: Thus deep roots and solid trunk, strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches.
translations.idiomatic: Thus deep roots and solid trunk—strengthen the trunk, weaken the branches.

sentences.zh: 靈太后將從之，從議者不同，乃止。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling was about to follow it; followers of other views differed, and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling was about to follow; other views differed, and it stopped.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾患，表求解任，不許。

translations.literal: Soon, because of illness, he memorialized asking to resign; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon illness made him ask to resign; it was refused.

sentences.zh: 澄以北邊鎮將選舉彌輕，恐賊虜窺邊，山陵危迫，奏求重鎮將之選，修警備之嚴，詔不從。

translations.literal: Cheng because northern frontier commanders' selection grew ever lighter, fearing barbarians would spy the border and the imperial tombs be endangered, memorialized asking to weight frontier commanders' choice and tighten guard and warning—an edict did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng feared frontier selection grew light, barbarians would spy the border and tombs be endangered, and asked to weight commanders and tighten guard—the edict did not follow.

sentences.zh: 後賊虜入寇，至於舊都，鎮將多非其人；

translations.literal: Later barbarians invaded to the old capital; commanders were mostly not the right men;
translations.idiomatic: Later barbarians invaded to the old capital; commanders were mostly wrong men;

sentences.zh: 所在叛亂，犯逼山陵，如澄所慮。

translations.literal: rebellion rose everywhere, pressing the tombs, as Cheng had feared.
translations.idiomatic: rebellion rose everywhere, pressing the tombs, as Cheng had feared.

sentences.zh: 澄奏：「都城府寺猶未周悉，今軍旅初寧，無宜發眾，請取諸職人及司州郡縣犯十杖以上、百鞭以下收贖之物，絹一匹輸磚二百，以漸修造。

translations.literal: Cheng memorialized: "Capital offices and temples are not yet complete; the army is newly quiet and the people should not be mobilized—take from functionaries and from Si Province and commanderies criminals from ten blows to a hundred lashes who may redeem with goods: one bolt of silk equals two hundred bricks, to repair step by step.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng memorialized, "Capital offices are not complete; the army is newly quiet—do not mobilize the people; take from functionaries and Si Province criminals from ten blows to a hundred lashes who redeem: one bolt of silk equals two hundred bricks, to repair step by step.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed.

sentences.zh: 太傅、清河王懌表駁其事，遂寢不行。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Prince of Qinghe Yi memorialized to reject the matter; it then slept and was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Prince of Qinghe Yi memorialized to reject it; it slept and was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 澄又奏：「司州牧、高陽王臣雍拷殺奉朝請韓元昭、前門下錄事姚敬賢，雖因公事，理實未盡。

translations.literal: Cheng again memorialized: "Inspector of Si Province, Prince of Gaoyang Yong, beat to death Court Attendant Han Yuanzhao and former Gate Office recorder Yao Jingxian—though on public business, reason was not exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng again memorialized, "Inspector of Si Province Prince of Gaoyang Yong beat Court Attendant Han Yuanzhao and former Gate recorder Yao Jingxian to death—though public business, reason was not exhausted.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: How so?
translations.idiomatic: How so?

sentences.zh: 若昭等狀彰，死罪以定，應刑於都市，與眾棄之。

translations.literal: If Zhao and the rest's guilt was manifest, death was fixed and they should be executed in the market and abandoned with the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: If Zhao and the rest's guilt was manifest, death was fixed—they should be executed in the market and abandoned with the crowd.

sentences.zh: 如其疑似不分，情理未究，不宜以三清九流之官，杖下便死，輕絕人命，傷理敗法。

translations.literal: If suspicion was not divided and reason not exhausted, one should not let officials of the three pure ranks and nine currents die under the staff at once, lightly cutting off life, harming reason and ruining law.
translations.idiomatic: If suspicion was not divided and reason not exhausted, officials of the three pure ranks and nine currents should not die under the staff at once, lightly cutting life and ruining law.

sentences.zh: 往年在州，於大市鞭殺五人，及檢賊狀，全無寸尺。

translations.literal: In years past in the province he flogged five men to death in the great market; on checking the bandits' case there was not a inch of truth.
translations.idiomatic: Years past in the province he flogged five to death in the great market; checking the bandits' case, not an inch of truth.

sentences.zh: 今復酷害，一至於此。

translations.literal: Now again cruel harm reaches this.
translations.idiomatic: Now again cruel harm reaches this.

sentences.zh: 朝野云云，咸懷驚愕。

translations.literal: Court and countryside murmur alike, all hold alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Court and countryside murmur; all hold alarm.

sentences.zh: 若生殺在下，虐專於臣，人君之權，安所復用？

translations.literal: If life and death lie below and cruelty is monopolized by a subject, where is the ruler's power again used?
translations.idiomatic: If life and death lie below and cruelty is monopolized by a subject, where is the ruler's power used?

sentences.zh: 請以見事付廷尉推究，驗其為劫之狀，察其拷殺之理。

translations.literal: Ask that the present matter be given to the Court of Justice for investigation, verifying the robbery case and examining the beating-to-death reason.
translations.idiomatic: Ask that the present matter go to the Court of Justice, verifying robbery and examining beating to death.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed.

sentences.zh: 澄當官無所回避。

translations.literal: In office Cheng avoided nothing.
translations.idiomatic: In office he avoided nothing.

sentences.zh: 又奏墾田授受之制八條，甚有綱貫。

translations.literal: He also memorialized eight articles on the system of granting and receiving reclaimed land, very coherent.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized eight articles on granting and receiving reclaimed land, very coherent.

sentences.zh: 西哉

translations.literal: The West
translations.idiomatic: The West

sentences.zh: 嚈噠、波斯諸國，各因公使，並遺澄駿馬一匹。

translations.literal: Yezhada, Persia, and other states, each on public embassy, all sent Cheng one fine horse.
translations.idiomatic: Yezhada, Persia, and other states on embassy each sent Cheng one fine horse.

sentences.zh: 澄請付太僕，以充國閑。

translations.literal: Cheng asked they be given to the Imperial Stud to fill the state herds.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng asked they be given to the Imperial Stud for state herds.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「王廉貞之德，有過楚相，可敕付廄，以成君子大哉之美。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "The king's integrity exceeds the Chu minister; order them to the stables to complete the gentleman's great beauty."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The king's integrity exceeds the Chu minister; order them to the stables to complete the gentleman's great beauty."

sentences.zh: 御史中尉、東平王匡奏請取景明元年以來內外考簿、吏部除書、中兵勳案並諸殿最，欲以案校竊階盜官之人。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Prince of Dongping Kuang memorialized asking to take from Jingming year onward internal and external examination registers, Ministry of Personnel appointment documents, Central Military merit records, and all grade rankings, intending to compare and verify men who stole rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Prince of Dongping Kuang asked registers from Jingming onward—examinations, appointments, merit records, grade rankings—to verify men who stole rank.

sentences.zh: 靈太后許之。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling permitted it.

sentences.zh: 澄表以為「御史之體，風聞是司。

translations.literal: Cheng memorialized that "the censor's body is to hear wind and report.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng memorialized that "the censor's body is to hear wind and report.

sentences.zh: 至於昌勳妄階，皆有處別。

translations.literal: As for false merit and reckless rank, each has its place of distinction.
translations.idiomatic: False merit and reckless rank each have their place.

sentences.zh: 若一處有風謠，即應攝其一簿，研檢虛實。

translations.literal: If in one place there is wind-rumor, one should seize that one register and investigate truth and falsehood.
translations.idiomatic: If in one place there is rumor, seize that register and investigate truth.

sentences.zh: 若差殊不同，偽情自露，然後繩以典刑，人誰不服？

translations.literal: If the difference is not the same, fraud shows itself; then apply the statutes—who will not submit?
translations.idiomatic: If difference shows, fraud shows itself; then apply statutes—who will not submit?

sentences.zh: 豈有移一省之事，窮革世之尤，如此求過，誰堪其罪？

translations.literal: How can one move one ministry's affairs and exhaust a generation's faults—seeking fault thus, who can bear the crime?
translations.idiomatic: How move one ministry's affairs and exhaust a generation's faults—seeking fault thus, who bears the crime?

sentences.zh: 斯實聖朝所宜重慎也。

translations.literal: This is truly what the sage court should heavily caution.
translations.idiomatic: This is what the sage court should heavily caution.

sentences.zh: 」靈太后納之，乃止。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling accepted it and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling accepted and stopped.

sentences.zh: 後遷司徒公，侍中、尚書令如故。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Minister of Works; palace attendance and leading the Masters of Writing were as before.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was minister of works; palace attendance and leading the Masters of Writing unchanged.

sentences.zh: 時太后銳于興繕，在京師則起永寧、太上公等佛寺，工費不少，外州各造五級佛圖。

translations.literal: At the time the empress dowager was keen on construction; in the capital she raised Yongning, Grand Supreme Duke, and other Buddhist temples at no small cost; outer provinces each built five-story pagodas.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was keen on construction; in the capital she raised Yongning and other temples at great cost; outer provinces each built five-story pagodas.

sentences.zh: 又數為一切齋會，施物動至萬計。

translations.literal: Again and again she held universal fast assemblies; gifts in motion reached tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Again and again she held universal fasts; gifts reached tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 百姓疲于土木之功，金銀之價為之踴上。

translations.literal: The people were worn by earth-and-wood labor; gold and silver prices leaped.
translations.idiomatic: The people were worn by earth and wood; gold and silver prices leaped.

sentences.zh: 削奪百官祿力，費損庫藏。

translations.literal: Officials' salary strength was stripped; the treasury was drained.
translations.idiomatic: Officials' salaries were stripped; the treasury drained.

sentences.zh: 兼曲賚左右，日有數千。

translations.literal: She also bent gifts to those at her side—several thousand a day.
translations.idiomatic: She also bent gifts to those at her side—several thousand a day.

sentences.zh: 澄上表極言得失。

translations.literal: Cheng memorialized at length on gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng memorialized at length on gain and loss.

sentences.zh: 雖卒不從，常優答禮之。

translations.literal: Though in the end it was not followed, she always answered with courteous favor.
translations.idiomatic: Though not followed in the end, she always answered with courteous favor.

sentences.zh: 政無大小，皆引參預。

translations.literal: Policy great and small all drew his participation.
translations.idiomatic: Policy great and small drew his participation.

sentences.zh: 澄亦盡心匡輔，事有不便於人者，必於諫諍，殷勤不已，內外咸敬憚之。

translations.literal: Cheng also gave his heart to support and correct; what was not convenient for the people he surely admonished again and again; inside and outside all respected and feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng gave his heart to support; what harmed the people he admonished again and again; inside and outside respected and feared him.

sentences.zh: 彝字子倫，繼室馮氏所生，頗有父風。

translations.literal: Yi, styled Zilun, was born of stepmother Lady Feng and had much of his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: Yi, styled Zilun, born of stepmother Lady Feng, had much of his father's manner.

sentences.zh: 拜通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He was made Unimpeded Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Unimpeded Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 及元叉專權而彝恥於托附，故不得顯職。

translations.literal: When Yuan Cha monopolized power Yi was ashamed to cling to him and therefore did not win prominent office.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Cha monopolized power Yi was ashamed to cling and did not win prominent office.

sentences.zh: 莊帝初，河陰遇害。

translations.literal: At the start of Emperor Zhuang he was killed at Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Zhuang he was killed at Heyin.

sentences.zh: 贈儀同三司、青州刺史，諡曰文。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies and Inspector of Qingzhou; posthumous title Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously given Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Qingzhou; posthumous title Wen.

sentences.zh: 彝庶長兄順，字子和。

translations.literal: Yi's elder brother by a concubine, Shun, styled Zihe.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's elder brother by a concubine, Shun, styled Zihe.

sentences.zh: 年九歲，師事樂安陳豐，初書王羲之《小學篇》數千言，晝夜誦之，旬有五日，一皆通徹。

translations.literal: At nine he took Master Chen Feng of Le'an as teacher; he first copied several thousand words of Wang Xizhi's Elementary Primer, reciting day and night; in fifteen days he penetrated all.
translations.idiomatic: At nine he took Chen Feng of Le'an; he copied Wang Xizhi's Elementary Primer, several thousand words, reciting day and night; in fifteen days he penetrated all.

sentences.zh: 豐奇之。

translations.literal: Feng marveled at him.
translations.idiomatic: Feng marveled.

sentences.zh: 白澄曰：「豐十五從師，迄于白首，耳目所經，未見此比，江夏黃童不得無雙也。

translations.literal: He told Cheng: "From fifteen I followed teachers to white-haired age; what eye and ear have passed I have never seen the like—Jiangxia's yellow boy cannot be without a pair.
translations.idiomatic: He told Cheng, "From fifteen I followed teachers to white hair; never seen the like—Jiangxia's yellow boy cannot be without a pair.

sentences.zh: 」澄笑曰：「藍田生玉，何容不爾。

translations.literal: Cheng smiled: "Lantian produces jade—how could it not be so.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng smiled, "Lantian produces jade—how could it not be so.

sentences.zh: 」十六通《杜氏春秋》，下帷讀書，篤志愛古。

translations.literal: At sixteen he mastered the Du clan Spring and Autumn; he lowered the curtain and read, his will fixed on loving antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: At sixteen he mastered the Du clan Spring and Autumn; he lowered the curtain to read, loving antiquity.

sentences.zh: 性謇愕，淡于榮利，好飲酒，解鼓琴。

translations.literal: By nature he was blunt and startled, indifferent to glory and profit, fond of wine, skilled at the zither.
translations.idiomatic: Blunt and startled by nature, indifferent to glory, fond of wine, skilled at zither.

sentences.zh: 每長吟永歎，托詠虛室。

translations.literal: He often long-chanted and sighed, entrusting his song to an empty room.
translations.idiomatic: He often long-chanted and sighed, entrusting song to an empty room.

sentences.zh: 宣武時，上《魏道頌》，文多不載。

translations.literal: Under Xuanwu he submitted the Wei Way Eulogy; much of the text is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuanwu he submitted the Wei Way Eulogy; much is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 起家為給事中。

translations.literal: He began office as Court Gentleman of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He began as Court Gentleman of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 時高肇權重，天下人士望塵拜伏。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Zhao held power; men of the realm bowed in the dust.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zhao held power; men bowed in the dust.

sentences.zh: 順曾懷刺詣肇門，門者以其年少，答云：「在坐大有貴客」。

translations.literal: Shun once carried a calling card to Zhao's gate; the gatekeeper, seeing him young, answered: "Inside sit many great guests."
translations.idiomatic: Shun carried a calling card to Zhao's gate; the gatekeeper, seeing him young, said, "Inside sit many great guests."

sentences.zh: 不肯為通。

translations.literal: He would not announce him.
translations.idiomatic: He would not announce him.

sentences.zh: 順叱之曰：「任城王兒可是賤也？

translations.literal: Shun rebuked him: "Can the son of Prince of Rencheng be base?
translations.idiomatic: Shun rebuked him, "Can the son of Prince of Rencheng be base?

sentences.zh: 」及見，直往登床，捧手抗禮，王公先達莫不怪懾；

translations.literal: On meeting he went straight to the couch, took his hand in equal courtesy; kings and dukes who came first all marveled and feared;
translations.idiomatic: On meeting he went straight to the couch with equal courtesy; kings and dukes marveled;

sentences.zh: 而順辭吐傲然，若無所睹。

translations.literal: yet Shun's words were proud, as though he saw no one.
translations.idiomatic: yet Shun's words were proud, as though he saw no one.

sentences.zh: 肇謂眾賓曰：「此兒豪氣尚爾，況其父乎！

translations.literal: Zhao told the gathered guests: "This boy's spirit is still so—how much more his father!
translations.idiomatic: Zhao told guests, "This boy's spirit is still so—how much more his father!

sentences.zh: 」及去，肇加敬送之。

translations.literal: When he left Zhao added respect and saw him off.
translations.idiomatic: When he left Zhao added respect and saw him off.

sentences.zh: 澄聞之大怒，杖之數十。

translations.literal: Cheng heard and was greatly angry; he caned him several tens of blows.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng heard and was greatly angry; he caned him tens of blows.

sentences.zh: 後拜太常少卿，以父憂去職，哭泣歐血，身自負土。

translations.literal: Later he was made Junior Master of Rites; he left office for his father's mourning, weeping until he vomited blood, carrying earth on his own back.
translations.idiomatic: Later junior master of rites; he left for his father's mourning, weeping until he vomited blood, carrying earth himself.

sentences.zh: 時年二十五，便有白髮，免喪抽去，不復更生，世人以為孝思所致。

translations.literal: At twenty-five he already had white hair; when mourning ended he plucked it and it did not grow again—the age thought it filial thought's doing.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-five he had white hair; when mourning ended he plucked it and it did not grow—the age thought filial thought.

sentences.zh: 尋除給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 時領軍元叉威勢尤盛，凡有遷授，莫不造門謝謁。

translations.literal: At the time Commander of the Guards Yuan Cha's power was especially great; whenever there was transfer or appointment none failed to visit his gate and pay court.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of the Guards Yuan Cha's power was especially great; on transfer none failed to visit and pay court.

sentences.zh: 順拜表而已，曾不詣叉。

translations.literal: Shun only submitted a memorial; he never called on Cha.
translations.idiomatic: Shun only submitted a memorial; he never called on Cha.

sentences.zh: 叉謂順曰：「卿何得聊不見我？

translations.literal: Cha said to Shun: "How can you simply not see me?
translations.idiomatic: Cha said, "How can you simply not see me?

sentences.zh: 」順正色曰：「天子富於春秋，委政宗輔，叔父宜以至公為心，舉士報國。

translations.literal: Shun said with stern face: "The Son of Heaven is rich in spring years and entrusts government to clan helpers; uncle should take utmost fairness as heart and raise men to repay the state.
translations.idiomatic: Shun said sternly, "The Son of Heaven is young and entrusts government to clan helpers; uncle should take fairness as heart and raise men for the state.

sentences.zh: 如何賣恩，責人私謝，豈所望也！

translations.literal: How sell favor and demand private thanks—is that what is hoped?
translations.idiomatic: How sell favor and demand private thanks—is that what is hoped?

sentences.zh: 」至於朝論得失，順常鯁言正議，曾不阿旨。

translations.literal: On court debate of gain and loss Shun often spoke straight and correct and never bent to intent.
translations.idiomatic: On court debate Shun often spoke straight and never bent.

sentences.zh: 由此見憚，出除恆州刺史。

translations.literal: Therefore he was feared and sent out as Inspector of Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he was feared and sent out as inspector of Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 順謂叉曰：「北鎮紛紜，方為國梗，請假都督，為國屏捍。

translations.literal: Shun told Cha: "The northern garrisons are in turmoil and are the state's thorn—grant me overall command as the state's screen.
translations.idiomatic: Shun told Cha, "Northern garrisons are in turmoil, the state's thorn—grant me overall command as screen.

sentences.zh: 」叉心疑難，不欲授以兵官，謂順曰：「此朝廷之事，非我所裁。

translations.literal: Cha's heart suspected difficulty and did not wish to give him a military post; he told Shun: "This is the court's affair—not mine to decide.
translations.idiomatic: Cha suspected and did not wish to give a military post; he said, "This is the court's affair—not mine to decide.

sentences.zh: 」順曰：「叔父既殺生由己，自言天曆應在我躬，何得復有朝廷？

translations.literal: Shun said: "Uncle already holds life and death in his hand and says the heavenly mandate should be on my person—how can there still be a court?
translations.idiomatic: Shun said, "Uncle holds life and death and says the mandate should be on me—how can there still be a court?

sentences.zh: 」叉彌忿憚之。

translations.literal: Cha grew ever more angry and feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Cha grew angrier and feared him.

sentences.zh: 轉齊州刺史。

translations.literal: Transferred to Inspector of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to inspector of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 順自負有才，不得居內，每懷鬱怏，形於言色。

translations.literal: Shun, confident in his talent, could not stay within and constantly nursed resentment, showing it in face and speech.
translations.idiomatic: Confident in talent, he could not stay within and nursed resentment in face and speech.

sentences.zh: 遂縱酒自娛，不親政事。

translations.literal: He then drank for pleasure and did not mind government.
translations.idiomatic: He drank for pleasure and did not mind government.

sentences.zh: 叉解領軍，徵為給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Cha was removed from commanding the guards; Shun was summoned as Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Cha was removed from the guards; Shun was summoned as Attendant of the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 親友郊迎，賀其得入。

translations.literal: Kin and friends met him at the suburbs, congratulating that he had entered.
translations.idiomatic: Kin met him at the suburbs, congratulating entry.

sentences.zh: 順曰：「不患不入，正恐入而復出耳。

translations.literal: Shun said: "I do not fear not entering—only fear entering and then leaving again.
translations.idiomatic: Shun said, "I do not fear not entering—only fear entering and leaving again.

sentences.zh: 」俄兼殿中尚書，轉侍中。

translations.literal: Soon he held the Palace Directorate concurrently; transferred to Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he held the Palace Directorate; transferred to palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 初，中山王熙起兵討元叉，不果而誅。

translations.literal: At first Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops to attack Yuan Cha and failed and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops against Yuan Cha, failed, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 及靈太后反政，方得改葬。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Ling returned to government, burial could at last be changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Ling returned to government, burial could be changed.

sentences.zh: 順侍坐西遊園，因奏太后曰：「臣昨往看中山家葬，非唯宗親哀其冤酷，行路士庶見一家十喪，皆為青族旐，莫不酸泣。

translations.literal: Shun sat in attendance at the Western Tour Garden and memorialized to the empress dowager: "Yesterday I went to view Prince of Zhongshan's burial—not only kin mourned his unjust suffering; travelers and commoners seeing one house with ten dead all wore green mourning flags and none did not weep sourly.
translations.idiomatic: Shun sat in the Western Tour Garden and told the empress dowager, "Yesterday I viewed Prince of Zhongshan's burial—not only kin mourned; travelers seeing ten dead in one house wore green flags and wept.

sentences.zh: 」叉妻時在太后側，順指之曰：「陛下奈何以一妹之故，不伏元叉之罪，使天下懷冤？

translations.literal: Cha's wife was then at the empress dowager's side; Shun pointed and said: "How can Your Majesty for one younger sister's sake not subdue Yuan Cha's crime and let the realm harbor injustice?
translations.idiomatic: Cha's wife was at her side; Shun pointed. "How for one younger sister not subdue Yuan Cha and let the realm harbor injustice?

sentences.zh: 」太后默然不語。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was silent and did not speak.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was silent.

sentences.zh: 就德興于營州反，使尚書盧同往討之，大敗而還。

translations.literal: De Xing of Yingzhou rebelled; Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Tong was sent to campaign and returned in great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: De Xing of Yingzhou rebelled; Lu Tong was sent to campaign and returned in great defeat.

sentences.zh: 屬侍中穆紹與順侍坐，因論同之罪。

translations.literal: It happened that Palace Attendant Mu Shao sat with Shun; they discussed Tong's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Mu Shao sat with Shun; they discussed Tong's crime.

sentences.zh: 同先有近宅借紹，紹頗欲為言。

translations.literal: Tong had earlier borrowed a nearby residence from Shao; Shao wished somewhat to speak for him.
translations.idiomatic: Tong had borrowed a nearby residence from Shao; Shao wished to speak for him.

sentences.zh: 順勃然曰：「盧同終將無罪！

translations.literal: Shun suddenly said: "Lu Tong in the end will be without crime!
translations.idiomatic: Shun suddenly said, "Lu Tong in the end will be without crime!

sentences.zh: 」太后曰：「何得如侍中之言？

translations.literal: The empress dowager said: "How can it be as the attendant says?
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said, "How can it be as the attendant says?

sentences.zh: 」順曰：「同有好宅與要勢侍中，豈慮罪也？

translations.literal: Shun said: "Tong gave a fine house to a powerful attendant—why worry about crime?
translations.idiomatic: Shun said, "Tong gave a fine house to a powerful attendant—why worry about crime?

sentences.zh: 」紹慚，不敢復言。

translations.literal: Shao was ashamed and dared not speak again.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was ashamed and dared not speak.

sentences.zh: 靈太后頗事妝飾，數出遊幸，順面諍之曰：「禮，婦人喪夫，自稱未亡人，首去珠珥，衣不被采。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling was much given to adornment and often went out on tours; Shun remonstrated to her face: "By rites, a woman who loses her husband calls herself the not-yet-dead; she removes pearl earrings and does not wear colored dress.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling adorned herself and often toured; Shun remonstrated, "By rites a widow calls herself not-yet-dead, removes pearls, wears no colored dress.

sentences.zh: 陛下母臨天下，年垂不惑，過修容飾，何以示後世？

translations.literal: Your Majesty mothers all under heaven and nears forty—excessive adornment, how show it to later ages?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty mothers the realm and nears forty—excessive adornment, how show later ages?

sentences.zh: 」靈太后慚而還入，召順責之曰：「千里相征，豈欲眾中見辱也！

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling was ashamed and returned inside; she summoned Shun and reproached him: "I summoned you a thousand li—did you wish to shame me before the crowd?
translations.idiomatic: She was ashamed and returned; she summoned Shun. "I summoned you a thousand li—did you wish to shame me before the crowd?

sentences.zh: 」順曰：「陛下盛服炫容，不畏天下所笑，何恥臣之一言乎！」

translations.literal: Shun said: "Your Majesty in splendid dress dazzles the realm and does not fear the world's laughter—why shame yourself at one word of mine?"
translations.idiomatic: Shun said, "Your Majesty dazzles the realm and does not fear laughter—why shame at one word of mine?"

sentences.zh: 初，城陽王徽慕順才名，偏相賞納。

translations.literal: At first Prince of Chengyang Hui admired Shun's talent and name and favored him especially.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chengyang Hui admired Shun's talent and favored him.

sentences.zh: 而廣陽王深通徽妻于氏，大為嫌隙。

translations.literal: But Prince of Guangyang Shen通 Hui's wife Lady Yu and a great rift opened.
translations.idiomatic: But Prince of Guangyang Shen通 Hui's wife Lady Yu—a great rift opened.

sentences.zh: 及深自定州被征，入為吏部尚書，兼中領軍，順為詔書，辭頗優美。

translations.literal: When Shen was summoned from Dingzhou and entered as Director of the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent command of the central guards, Shun drafted the edict, the wording quite beautiful.
